title.v: Phân quyền thông tin truy vấn dữ liệu bán hàng

query.text: declare @strKey nvarchar(128) set @strKey = 'is_user = ' + dbo.ISWIFTFunctionReplaceSQLParam(@xtype) + ' and admin = 0 and status = 1' exec ISWIFTStoreTableLoading '@@table', '@@fieldKey', '@@fields', @@fieldOrder, '', '', '', '', '@@key', @strKey, @@filterKey, '', @pageIndex, 50, @@admin, @@userId

request.text: if @@admin = 0 select '$AdminAccess' as message else if @user_id = @@userId select '$NotAuthorized' as message else select '' as message
